newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Ivory Coast - June 25.

text.p: These are significant items in the Ivorian press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these items and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Ivory Coast government plans crack down on civil service sloppiness, inefficiency and corruption; offers to look at appropriate rewards for those who work well

- Air Afrique Managing director Sir Harry Tirvengadum says privatisation of the multinational carrier will not be an issue before the year 2002 and that member states must retain a stake; resolution of the debt problem tops his short-term agenda

- Ivory Coast national assembly passes five new laws including one on counterfeit money and one on exchange controls. The latter fixes penalties of one to three months in jail and a fine of half to double the sum of money involved.
